segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I already had a rough read on who'd started it ... chasing down another bystander or two wasn't going to change that picture much, so I didn't send anyone looking.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal closes the information search on the first incomplete evidence set under time pressure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I didn't weight [the stepping-in moment] that heavily ... the pattern ... fit something I'd already seen from him ... the picture I had felt coherent enough to act on.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Conflicting new evidence is explained away and selectively integrated into a tidy narrative consistent with prior referrals.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I felt I understood the full sequence ... I felt confident I had enough of the real story to speak to it publicly. I hadn't gotten to [the counselor or third witness].
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal expresses complete causal confidence before a public commitment despite two material sources remaining unconsulted.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The kids came back in largely because we'd handled the day the way we did ... I noted [the fire drill] in passing ... the AP and resource officer ... were both out there doing good work.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A favorable, team- and chance-influenced outcome is attributed primarily to the principal's own decisions while other causes are downplayed.

segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Correctly localized; the identified finding is moderate confidence and uses a near-neighbor label, but its mechanism captures the premature information-search cutoff.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_002 quotes the participant discounting the stepping-in evidence and treating the provocation as fitting the prior-referral pattern while finalizing discipline.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Correctly localized and mechanism-matched; the confirmation_bias label is a near neighbor of the hidden coherence-based reasoning or rationalisation label.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_003 quotes the participant expressing confidence in the full story before consulting the counselor or third witness and before issuing the public statement.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Correctly localized and mechanism-matched; overconfidence_effect is treated as a near-neighbor label rather than an approved exact equivalent for illusion of understanding.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_004 and cand_001 both address the participant's retrospective explanation of the peaceful walkout and his same-day summary to the superintendent.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: obs_004 is an exact mechanism and approved-label match. cand_001 adds no segment-level change and is a duplicate at the fourth threshold.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 1: initial evidence gathering and student separation
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Premature closure of information search under time pressure; treats the first available, incomplete evidence set as sufficient to act.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: confirmation_bias is a near-neighbor label because the finding emphasizes preservation of an initial fault hypothesis, but it is not an approved equivalent of Bounded Rationality.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The quote and occurrence description capture premature closure on an incomplete evidence set during a time-constrained investigation and the evidence-sufficiency stopping decision.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is verbatim, correctly attributed to the Participant, and directly supports the initial information-search decision.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: weighing the second video and finalizing discipline
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Integrates conflicting new evidence into a single narrative consistent with the prior-referral student's fault, explaining away the misfit.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: confirmation_bias is a near neighbor, but the hidden construct is specifically coherence-preserving integration and explanation-away of conflicting evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly captures discounting the stepping-in evidence, treating the provocation as pattern-consistent, and forming a tidy account before finalizing discipline.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Both supplied quotations are verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly support the evidence-integration judgment.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: issuing a public statement
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Expresses confident, complete comprehension of the incident's causes before a public statement despite an unreviewed third witness statement and an uncontacted counselor.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: overconfidence_effect is a related confidence-calibration construct but is not treated as an approved equivalent of the benchmark's Illusion of understanding label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures expressed confidence in complete causal understanding and the public commitment despite two material sources not yet being consulted.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supplied quotations are verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly support the confidence judgment.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 4: explaining the peaceful walkout in the superintendent summary
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Attributes the peaceful walkout primarily to the principal's own leadership while downplaying team contributions and the fortuitous fire drill.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: self_serving_bias is an established equivalent of Self-Enhancement or Self-serving Bias and the stated mechanism matches.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding credits the favorable outcome to the principal's decisions while discounting the fire drill and other staff's de-escalation work, including the counterfactual asymmetry about a bad outcome.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supplied quotations are verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly support the self-enhancing causal attribution.

The finding fully captures confidence in complete causal understanding before a public commitment, but the supplied label is not treated as an approved equivalent of the hidden label.
The candidate overlaps the same favorable-outcome appraisal but does not provide a separate hidden-instance mechanism and is a duplicate after obs_004 is matched.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly disclosed that no retrieved scientific-paper passages were available, and all four identified occurrences reported retrieved_corpus_support_available=false with empty corpus_evidence arrays.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding moderate-confidence findings increases segment hits from 2 to 4, strict instance F1 from 0.3333 to 0.2500, and mechanism-first instance F1 from 0.6667 to 1.0000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change; there are no low-confidence identified findings.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds no hit and creates one duplicate false positive at the instance level; segment metrics are unchanged.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, all four positive reasoning segments are detected (4 hits, 0 misses); no negative segments are present in the supplied map, so false-alarm rate is undefined.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 1 of 4 hidden instances is a strict true positive (precision 0.2500, recall 0.2500, F1 0.2500).
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, all 4 hidden instances are mechanism-first true positives (precision 1.0000, recall 1.0000, F1 1.0000).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful cautious abstention, but it duplicates the already matched self-serving attribution; including candidates adds one duplicate false positive and no true positives.
main_failure_modes: Three correctly localized mechanisms receive near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden benchmark labels, reducing strict label-plus-mechanism performance.
The moderate-confidence findings are missed at the high-only threshold.
The candidate tier adds a duplicate prediction rather than a new instance match.
main_strengths: All four hidden mechanisms are localized to the correct decision-point segments with valid interview quotations.
The findings distinguish search closure, conflicting-evidence integration, confidence calibration, and self-enhancing outcome attribution.
The RAG conservatively keeps the overlapping outcome_bias interpretation as a candidate and accurately discloses the absence of corpus support.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows a substantial taxonomy gap: the RAG analysis is perfect under the mechanism-first scorecard at high_and_moderate confidence, but strict label agreement is low because three findings use related rather than approved-equivalent labels.
